title: World Heritage landmarks and their country

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) WHERE { ?item wdt:P1435 wd:Q9259 ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 30) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q486972 } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5119 } FILTER(?item NOT IN (wd:Q172077, wd:Q12192963)) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 82

theLabels: Basilica and Expiatory Church of the Holy Family

country.match: Match each landmark to its country.
country.odd: Three of these landmarks are in {value}. Which one isn't?

exclude.why: Grand Canal: players think of Venice; the name is ambiguous

rows.label: Basilica and Expiatory Church of the Holy Family
rows.description: basilica under construction since 1882 in Barcelona, Spain
rows.hook: was designed by Antoni Gaudí and has been under construction for more than a century

rows.label: Taj Mahal
rows.description: marble mausoleum in Agra, India
rows.hook: was built by an emperor as a tomb for his beloved wife

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.description: monument in New York
rows.hook: was a gift from the French people and holds a torch aloft in a harbor

rows.label: Lake Baikal
rows.description: freshwater rift lake in southern Siberia, Russia; the greatest mountain lake in Asia and the most voluminous freshwater lake in the world
rows.hook: holds more fresh water than any other lake on Earth

rows.label: Stonehenge
rows.description: Neolithic henge monument in Amesbury, Wiltshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is a mysterious circle of massive standing stones on an ancient plain

rows.label: Cologne Cathedral
rows.description: Roman-Catholic cathedral in Cologne, Germany
rows.hook: has soaring twin spires that took generations of builders to finish

rows.label: Hadrian's Wall
rows.description: defensive fortification in Roman Britain
rows.hook: was built by Romans to mark the northern edge of their empire

rows.label: Palace of Versailles
rows.description: palace in Versailles, France and location of the Museum of the History of France
rows.hook: was the opulent home of kings and features a dazzling hall of mirrors

rows.label: Tower of London
rows.description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: has guarded the crown jewels for ages and is watched over by ravens

rows.label: Galapagos Islands
rows.description: Archipelago in the Pacific Ocean, part of Ecuador since 1832
rows.hook: inspired a famous theory of evolution with its unique wildlife

rows.label: Teotihuacan
rows.description: ancient Mesoamerican city
rows.hook: features towering pyramids built by a mysterious ancient civilization

rows.label: Mount Olympus
rows.description: mountain in Elassona municipality, Greece
rows.hook: was believed by ancient storytellers to be the home of their gods

rows.label: Great Barrier Reef
rows.description: over 2300 km long coral reef off Australia's northeast coast, UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is the largest living structure on Earth, built by tiny coral animals

rows.label: Sydney Opera House
rows.description: multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
rows.hook: has a roof shaped like billowing sails overlooking a harbor

rows.label: Giant's Causeway
rows.description: rock formation on the Antrim coast of Northern Ireland
rows.hook: is made of thousands of interlocking hexagonal rock columns said to be built by a legend

rows.label: Nazca Lines
rows.description: large geoglyphs made in the soil of the Nazca Desert in Peru
rows.hook: are giant desert drawings of animals so large they're best seen from the air

rows.label: Ajanta Caves
rows.description: 2nd century BCE to 1st century CE Buddhist cave monuments located in Maharashtra, India
rows.hook: houses ancient paintings and sculptures carved into a cliffside

rows.label: Qutb Minar
rows.description: minaret in the Mehrauli area of Delhi, India
rows.hook: is one of the tallest brick minarets in the world

rows.label: Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba
rows.description: cathedral (former mosque) in Cordoba, Spain
rows.hook: began as a place of Islamic worship and was later turned into a Christian church

rows.label: Appian Way
rows.description: Roman highway from Rome, Italy, to Brundisium 312 BC
rows.hook: was one of the earliest and most important roads of the ancient world

rows.label: Grand Canal
rows.description: longest canal or artificial river in the world located in China
rows.hook: is the longest artificial waterway ever built by human hands

rows.label: Himeji Castle
rows.description: Japanese castle complex
rows.hook: is called the White Heron for its brilliant white walls

rows.label: Ellora Caves
rows.description: ancient cave temples of Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism in Maharashtra, India
rows.hook: features temples of three different faiths carved from a single cliff

rows.label: Meteora
rows.description: rock formation with cluster of Greek Orthodox monasteries
rows.hook: has monasteries perched atop towering rock pillars

rows.label: Lumbini
rows.description: Buddhist pilgrimage site in Nepal
rows.hook: is honored as the birthplace of a great spiritual teacher

rows.label: Temple of Heaven
rows.description: imperial complex of religious buildings in Beijing, China
rows.hook: was where emperors once prayed for good harvests

rows.label: Grand Canyon National Park
rows.description: national park in Coconino and Mohave counties in Arizona, United States
rows.hook: is a mile-deep gorge carved over ages by a mighty river

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Chartres
rows.description: medieval Catholic cathedral in Chartres, France
rows.hook: is famed for its stunning medieval stained-glass windows and twin towers

rows.label: Hiroshima Peace Memorial
rows.description: architectural structure
rows.hook: was left standing near ground zero of the first atomic bombing and is now a UNESCO site

rows.label: Mount Tai
rows.description: mountain in Shandong, China
rows.hook: has been a sacred pilgrimage site for emperors and poets for ages

rows.label: Agra Fort
rows.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is a massive red sandstone fortress near a famous white marble mausoleum

rows.label: Okavango Delta
rows.description: river delta in Botswana
rows.hook: is a vast inland river system that floods a desert into a lush wetland
